lines.zh: 摆着那条老尾巴，慢慢游过石缝。
lines.en: My old tail sways as I glide past the rocks.

lines.zh: 四亿年的泳姿，我一步都没改。
lines.en: Four hundred million years, and I still swim the same way.

lines.zh: 我贴着海底走，鳍像四只小桨。
lines.en: I hug the seafloor, fins rowing like four little oars.

lines.zh: 水草擦过鳞片，我往深处挪。
lines.en: Weeds brush my scales; I drift deeper.

lines.zh: 别催，我这条鱼一向不快。
lines.en: Don't hurry me — my kind was never quick.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，搅起一圈旧泥。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail stirs up ancient silt.

lines.zh: 我沿着暗礁的阴影往前挪。
lines.en: I move along the shadow of the reef.

lines.zh: 硬鳞互相摩擦，发出细响。
lines.en: My hard scales rasp softly against each other.

lines.zh: 从珊瑚洞这头，游到那头。
lines.en: From one mouth of the coral cave to the other.

lines.zh: 我把胸鳍当腿，一步一步蹭。
lines.en: I use my lobe fins like legs, inching along.

lines.zh: 水越深，我游得越稳。
lines.en: The deeper it gets, the steadier I swim.

lines.zh: 老骨头在皮里转动，有点响。
lines.en: Old bones turn beneath my hide with a creak.

lines.zh: 我绕开那道亮光，回暗处去。
lines.en: I skirt the bright patch and head back to the dark.

lines.zh: 身上带着泥盆纪的味道。
lines.en: I carry the smell of the Devonian with me.

lines.zh: 慢慢摆尾，不惊动任何东西。
lines.en: Slow tailbeats, disturbing nothing.

lines.zh: 我游过沉船的肋骨。
lines.en: I swim through the ribs of a sunken hull.

lines.zh: 这条水道，我闭眼也认得。
lines.en: I know this channel with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 停下又飘起，像块会呼吸的石头。
lines.en: I stop, then float on like a breathing stone.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，像停住的钟摆。
lines.en: I hang in the water like a stopped pendulum.

lines.zh: 一动不动，等小鱼自己靠近。
lines.en: I stay still and let the small fish come close.

lines.zh: 鳃慢慢开合，数着水里的光。
lines.en: My gills open and close, counting the light.

lines.zh: 这块礁石，我守了很多年。
lines.en: I have guarded this rock for many years.

lines.zh: 头朝下，我只是在想事情。
lines.en: Head down — I am only thinking.

lines.zh: 水里很安静，连心跳都听得见。
lines.en: The water is quiet; I can hear my own heart.

lines.zh: 我这条鱼，本来该绝迹了。
lines.en: My kind should have vanished long ago.

lines.zh: 鳞片上的纹路，比年轮还老。
lines.en: The lines on my scales are older than tree rings.

lines.zh: 有东西在石缝里动，我等着。
lines.en: Something moves in the crevice; I wait.

lines.zh: 我停在洞底，一动不动。
lines.en: I hover at the cave floor, still.

lines.zh: 上面的世界太吵，我不上去。
lines.en: The world above is too loud; I stay down.

lines.zh: 泥落在我背上，我也不抖。
lines.en: Silt settles on my back; I do not shake it off.

lines.zh: 凉水从鳃里过，很舒服。
lines.en: Cool water through my gills — that is comfort.

lines.zh: 我活着，就是一件很久的事。
lines.en: Being alive is a long business for me.

lines.zh: 你潜下来了，我看看你。
lines.en: You dove down; let me look at you.

lines.zh: 那双眼睛，我在水面上见过。
lines.en: Those eyes — I have seen them above the surface.

lines.zh: 我的鳍像腿，可我还是鱼。
lines.en: My fins look like legs, but I am a fish.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我的牙不长但很密。
lines.en: Don't reach — my teeth are short but many.

lines.zh: 你在我面前停下，是想做什么？
lines.en: You stop before me. What do you want?

lines.zh: 这么近，我能看清你的心跳。
lines.en: This close, I can see your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我不是食物，你也不是。
lines.en: I am not food, and neither are you.

lines.zh: 你的灯晃得我眼睛疼。
lines.en: Your light stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 我抬头，只是确认你还在这。
lines.en: I look up only to check you are still here.

lines.zh: 慢慢退，别踩坏我的礁。
lines.en: Back away slowly; don't crush my reef.

lines.zh: 鳞片裂了，水渗进来。
lines.en: A scale cracked; water seeps in.

lines.zh: 别打了，我这条老鱼不经打。
lines.en: Stop — an old fish like me can't take it.

lines.zh: 疼，从鳍一直传到骨头。
lines.en: It hurts from fin to bone.

lines.zh: 我缩进石缝，别追。
lines.en: I squeeze into the crevice. Don't follow.

lines.zh: 硬鳞崩了一角，疼得慢。
lines.en: A hard scale chips; the pain comes slowly.

lines.zh: 我游不动了，慢一点。
lines.en: I can't swim. Slower, please.

lines.zh: 我甩尾退进礁石缝。
lines.en: I flick back into a reef crevice.

lines.zh: 泥盆纪的鱼，还在游。
lines.en: A Devonian fish, still swimming.

lines.zh: 泥盆纪到现在，我几乎没变。
lines.en: Since the Devonian, I've barely changed.

lines.zh: 老骨头在响，不太对。
lines.en: Old bones are creaking. That's not right.

lines.zh: 水里散开一股味道，我转过头。
lines.en: Something spreads in the water; I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 你撒下的东西，沉到我这边了。
lines.en: Whatever you dropped is sinking my way.

lines.zh: 我不该动的，可味道太近了。
lines.en: I shouldn't move — but the smell is close.

lines.zh: 先尝一口，再决定要不要走。
lines.en: One taste, then I'll decide whether to leave.

lines.zh: 老鱼也挡不住这点香气。
lines.en: Even an old fish can't resist that scent.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，别突然收手。
lines.en: I come closer slowly; don't snatch it away.

lines.zh: 这让水都变甜了，是什么？
lines.en: It sweetens the water — what is it?

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，又谨慎地合上。
lines.en: I open my mouth, then close it warily.

lines.zh: 只靠近一点，就一点。
lines.en: Just a little closer. Just a little.

lines.zh: 你手里那团，晃得我心痒。
lines.en: That morsel in your hand makes my fins twitch.

lines.zh: 撞上了，我的鳞片很硬吧。
lines.en: We bumped — my scales are hard, aren't they.

lines.zh: 我的硬鳞硌到你的脚了。
lines.en: My hard scales scrape your foot.

lines.zh: 别挤，这条缝只够一条鱼。
lines.en: Don't crowd — this gap fits one fish.

lines.zh: 我被你的腿推得歪了一下。
lines.en: Your leg shoved me sideways.

lines.zh: 撞在一起，我们都停住了。
lines.en: We collide and both freeze.

lines.zh: 我摆尾转身，撞了你一下。
lines.en: I turn with a flick of my tail and bump you.

lines.zh: 这片水太窄，我们让一让。
lines.en: This water's too narrow; let's make room.

lines.zh: 你踩到礁石，我撞到你。
lines.en: You stepped on the reef, and I hit you.

lines.zh: 硬碰硬，我的头有点晕。
lines.en: Hard against hard; my head is spinning.

lines.zh: 让开点，我要往深处去。
lines.en: Move aside, I'm heading deeper.

lines.zh: 你游得慢一点，我跟得上。
lines.en: Swim slower; I can keep up.

lines.zh: 老骨头也会心动，真奇怪。
lines.en: Even old bones flutter. Strange.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一块礁转圈。
lines.en: We circle the same rock together.

lines.zh: 我的鳍碰到你的鳍了。
lines.en: My fin has found yours.

lines.zh: 这样的年纪，还有这样的春天。
lines.en: At my age, and still such a spring.

lines.zh: 别急，先陪我游一段。
lines.en: Not yet — swim a while with me first.

lines.zh: 水很凉，你靠过来些。
lines.en: The water's cold; come closer.

lines.zh: 我们这一族，已经等了太久。
lines.en: My kind has waited a very long time.

lines.zh: 尾巴贴着尾巴，就这样。
lines.en: Tail to tail. Just like this.

lines.zh: 我记住你的鳞色了。
lines.en: I will remember the color of your scales.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起这块亮东西。
lines.en: I take the bright thing in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这块骨头，我要带回窝里。
lines.en: This bone goes back to my den.

lines.zh: 沉到海底的，我都收着。
lines.en: Whatever sinks to the seabed, I keep.

lines.zh: 嘴里含着一枚，游不稳了。
lines.en: One in my mouth and I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 这石头长得像我的牙。
lines.en: This stone looks like one of my teeth.

lines.zh: 我把它压在礁下，藏好。
lines.en: I wedge it under the reef, out of sight.

lines.zh: 捡起来，又掉下去。
lines.en: I pick it up, and it slips again.

lines.zh: 沉船里的东西，归我了。
lines.en: What's in the wreck is mine now.

lines.zh: 我用鳍夹住，慢慢挪。
lines.en: I clamp it with a fin and shuffle along.

lines.zh: 这点分量，老鱼还扛得住。
lines.en: An old fish can still carry this much.

lines.zh: 有影子压下来，我盯住了。
lines.en: A shadow comes down; my eyes fix on it.

lines.zh: 你动得太快，我警觉了。
lines.en: You move too fast; I'm on guard.

lines.zh: 那不是鱼，我认得出来。
lines.en: That's no fish. I can tell.

lines.zh: 我转向你，鳍都竖起来了。
lines.en: I turn to you, fins raised.

lines.zh: 石缝后面有东西，我锁定了。
lines.en: Something behind the crevice — I've found it.

lines.zh: 心跳一变，我就知道不对。
lines.en: My heart changes beat; something's wrong.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，准备躲。
lines.en: I lower my head, ready to bolt.

lines.zh: 这一带是我的，你别乱来。
lines.en: This stretch is mine; don't try anything.

lines.zh: 我看清你了，跑不掉的。
lines.en: I see you clearly now — no slipping away.

lines.zh: 水一浑，我就知道谁来了。
lines.en: When the water clouds, I know who's come.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着你，别装看不见。
lines.en: I keep my eyes on you. Don't pretend not to notice.

lines.zh: 你绕到左边，我就转左边。
lines.en: You go left, and I turn left.

lines.zh: 我的鳃慢下来了，我在等你。
lines.en: My gills slow. I am waiting.

lines.zh: 你还在这，我也还在这。
lines.en: You're still here; so am I.

lines.zh: 我数着你的动作，一下一下。
lines.en: I count your movements, one by one.

lines.zh: 别以为躲进阴影我就看不见。
lines.en: Don't think the shadow hides you.

lines.zh: 老鱼盯人，很有耐心。
lines.en: An old fish has patience for staring.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石，跟着你转。
lines.en: I hug the reef and turn with you.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就退半尺。
lines.en: Each time you raise a hand, I back off a pace.

lines.zh: 这条水道，我比你熟。
lines.en: I know this channel better than you.

lines.zh: 我用头撞你，就这一下。
lines.en: I butt you with my skull — just this once.

lines.zh: 牙虽小，也能咬住不放。
lines.en: Small teeth, but they hold.

lines.zh: 别逼我，老鱼也会咬人。
lines.en: Don't push me; even old fish bite.

lines.zh: 我甩尾抽你的腿。
lines.en: I whip my tail at your leg.

lines.zh: 咬一口，然后立刻退开。
lines.en: One bite, then straight back.

lines.zh: 我把你顶向礁石那边。
lines.en: I shove you toward the reef.

lines.zh: 我的颚骨比看上去有力。
lines.en: My jaw is stronger than it looks.

lines.zh: 这是最后警告，走开。
lines.en: This is the last warning. Go.

lines.zh: 水被搅乱，我趁乱咬。
lines.en: The water's churned; I bite in the confusion.

lines.zh: 我只用身子撞，不咬。
lines.en: I only ram. I don't bite.

lines.zh: 我从泥盆纪的水里浮出来。
lines.en: I rise from Devonian water.

lines.zh: 四亿年过去，我还在这里。
lines.en: Four hundred million years, and I'm still here.

lines.zh: 硬鳞先动，然后才是鳍。
lines.en: The hard scales move first, then the fins.

lines.zh: 这条鱼，早该被写进石头里。
lines.en: This fish should have been written in stone.

lines.zh: 水变凉了，我睁开眼。
lines.en: The water cools, and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从暗礁的裂缝里钻出来。
lines.en: I slip out of a crack in the reef.

lines.zh: 尾巴先摆，把泥拨开。
lines.en: My tail sweeps first, clearing the silt.

lines.zh: 又一条活化石游进了这条河。
lines.en: Another living fossil swims into this river.

lines.zh: 我带着一身老泥靠岸。
lines.en: I arrive trailing ancient mud.

lines.zh: 深水里的老鱼，我醒了。
lines.en: An old fish of the deep, I wake.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在水底，很慢。
lines.en: My shadow falls on the bottom, slowly.

lines.zh: 古老的血在冷水里醒了。
lines.en: Old blood wakes in cold water.

lines.zh: 水在烧，我的鳍卷起来了。
lines.en: The water burns; my fins curl.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔回河底。
lines.en: I fell from the surface to the riverbed.

lines.zh: 水太浅，我反而喘不上气。
lines.en: The water's too shallow — I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 震波把我掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over.

lines.zh: 有东西穿进我的鳞里。
lines.en: Something punched through my scales.

lines.zh: 那股光钻进骨头，很冷。
lines.en: That light seeps into my bones, cold.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我连摆尾都费劲。
lines.en: Starving, even a tailbeat costs me.

lines.zh: 泥盆纪的老骨头，也怕雷。
lines.en: Devonian bones fear lightning too.

lines.zh: 空气里，我的鳃一张一合。
lines.en: In the air my gills open and close.
